build_semsegseqnet: build a SemSegSeqNet with RGB, depth, and semantic encoders for robot navigation policy
build_semsegseqmodel: build a SemSegSeqModel that wraps SemSegSeqNet with a categorical action distribution head
run_semsegseqnet_forward: run the SemSegSeqNet forward pass with observations, RNN hidden states, prev actions, and masks
extract_sge: extract the semantic goal embedding and goal segmentation mask from observations using _extract_sge
review_task_cat2mpcat40: review the task_cat2mpcat40 mapping from task categories to Matterport3D 40-class semantic IDs
